components.name: Publish Button
components.description: The single primary action on the page.
components.css: .ds-publish { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-on-accent); border: 0; border-radius: 2px; font: 800 1.25rem/1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-publish:hover { background: var(--color-accent-ink); } .ds-publish:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-biro); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-publish:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Press Bar Button
components.description: Download actions on the ink press bar.
components.css: .ds-press-btn { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-paper-3); border-radius: 2px; font: 800 0.9375rem/1 var(--font-display); cursor: pointer; } .ds-press-btn:hover { background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-press-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-paper); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Drop Zone
components.description: Where a student or lecturer file is dropped.
components.css: .ds-drop { display: grid; gap: 4px; place-content: center; text-align: center; min-height: 6.5rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--color-paper-2); border: 1px dashed var(--color-ink-3); font: 400 1.0625rem/1.4 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; } .ds-drop strong { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; } .ds-drop span { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-drop:hover { border-color: var(--color-biro); }

components.css: .ds-lect { border-top: 3px solid var(--color-ink); padding-top: 8px; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.5 var(--font-body); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-lect h3 { font: 800 1.25rem/1.15 var(--font-display); margin: 0; } .ds-f { font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--color-ink-2); margin: 2px 0 6px; } .ds-load { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; font: 600 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-display); } .ds-load i { width: 14px; height: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink); } .ds-load i.on { background: var(--color-ink); } .ds-lect ol { padding-left: 1.4rem; margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-lect li { border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--color-rule-soft); padding: 4px 0; } .ds-lect small { font: 400 0.8125rem/1 var(--font-display); color: var(--color-ink-2); } .ds-lect li.weak span { border: 1.5px solid var(--color-biro); border-radius: 62% 38% 55% 45% / 58% 46% 54% 42%; padding: 0 0.45em; display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-2deg); }

narrative.overview: The result is published like a newspaper allocation supplement: a masthead in type, equal ruled columns, and a coordinator's blue biro marking what needs a look. Paper and ink carry the hierarchy; green is the press, blue is the pen.
keyCharacteristics: Equal-scale lecturer columns with exact load cells
Biro marks for attention and hand edits

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Green is the press (one action), blue is the pen (attention and edits). Neither decorates.

rules.name: The Scale-Only Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from type size and weight; no eyebrows, badges or cards.

dos: Do keep one green action per screen.
Do mark attention only with biro circle, underline or numeral.
Do keep lecturer columns at one scale.
donts: Don't add cards, badges or coloured side borders.
Don't replay entrance motion on edits.
